summary: The Space launch space is anchored by well-funded leaders such as SpaceX, Rocket Lab, Relativity Space, which set the pace on capability and distribution. A wave of earlier-stage challengers — including a long tail of earlier-stage entrants — competes on focused differentiation and specific customer segments.
